author: SethDGamre + Egzothicki
description: For games with the Zombies modoption. Shows a countdown over every wreck telling you exactly when it reanimates, straight from the timer the game now publishes for this purpose. White with plenty of time, purple as the rise nears, pulsing in the final seconds. Reclaim resets are picked up instantly, and a purple '?' marks fogged wrecks whose timer may have changed unseen. Display only.
